segments.sn14.6:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dhātunānattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi.
segments.sn14.6:1.3: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamañca, bhikkhave, dhātunānattaṃ?
segments.sn14.6:1.5: Rūpadhātu saddadhātu gandhadhātu rasadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu dhammadhātu – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dhātunānattan”ti.
